description.en: The compute resources of the SaaS service.

description.zh:
计费类型，取值如下：

- **Postpaid**：按量付费
- **Prepaid**：包年包月

> - 如果不填，则会默认创建Free免费类型的。
> - 包年包月计费模式下，一次性购买一年及以上时长时会有一定优惠，建议您按需选择计费类型。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.

> - If you leave this parameter empty, a Free type is created by default.
> - The subscription billing method offers discounts for purchases of one year or longer. Select a billing method as needed.

description.zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值如下：
- **Month**：月
- **Year**：年

> 创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数。
description.en:
The unit of the duration for which you want to purchase the resource. Valid values:
- **Month**: month.
- **Year**: year.

> This parameter is required when you create a subscription instance.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
购买资源的时长。取值如下：
- 当**Period**为**Month**时，取值为1~11。
- 当**Period**为**Year**时，取值为1~3。

> 创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数。
description.en:
The duration for which you want to purchase the resource. Valid values:
- If **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values are 1 to 11.
- If **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values are 1 to 3.

> This parameter is required when you create a subscription instance.
The workspace of the SaaS service.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版产品的[收费方式](~~35406~~)和<props="china">[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/gpdb/detail/GreenplumPost)</props><props="intl">[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/hybriddb-postgresql/pricing)</props>。
descriptions.en: Before you use this operation, make sure that you fully understand the [billing methods](~~35406~~) and <props="china">[pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/gpdb/detail/GreenplumPost)</props><props="intl">[pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/hybriddb-postgresql/pricing)</props> of AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-saas-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --workspace-id ws-00000 --service-type drama --pay-type Postpaid --used-time 1 --period Month --cu 1 --plan deprecated --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateSaasService --region cn-hangzhou --Cu 1 --ServiceType drama --WorkspaceId 'ws-00000' --UsedTime 1 --Period Month --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType Postpaid --Plan deprecated
